components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: An alert with a title, a message and buttons, the last the default: macOS's NSAlert, Windows 11's ContentDialog with the default button first, or GNOME's AdwAlertDialog. The index returned is the same on every platform.

components.name: Button
components.description: A push button: macOS's push button, Windows 11's button with its elevation border, or GNOME's text button; in a Toolbar, the platform's toolbar item: a 36-point capsule on macOS, an AppBarButton on Windows 11, a raised text button on GNOME.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A check box with a label, sized and filled as the platform draws its own.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: A field whose text filters a list of options, in the platform's text field box; the list is MyGo's.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A dialog over the window: a sheet with a window's shadow on macOS, which leaves the window undimmed, a ContentDialog on Windows 11, or a floating AdwDialog over a dimmed window on GNOME.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: A field editing a number with buttons stepping it: an NSTextField with an NSStepper beside it on macOS, a NumberBox with its inline spin buttons on Windows 11, or a GtkSpinButton with − and + after the text on GNOME. Rebuilt from ui.TextInputBase and ui.ButtonBase as ui.NumberInput is, with its keys, Tab order and Decrease and Increase buttons.

components.name: PrimaryButton
components.description: The main action in the accent color: macOS's default button, Windows 11's accent button or GNOME's suggested action; in a Toolbar, the platform's toolbar item.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A progress bar, or a moving one for a negative value: macOS's bar, Windows 11's thin ProgressBar, or GNOME's progress bar.

components.name: Radio
components.description: A radio button with a label: macOS's 16-point radio button, Windows 11's RadioButton with its growing dot, or GNOME's grouped check button.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: The group radio buttons choose within, which the arrows move through, its radio buttons set as far apart as the platform sets them: 6 points down a column and 8 across a row on macOS, as SwiftUI's radio-group picker; RadioButtons' row spacing 8 and column spacing 7 on Windows 11; the padded check buttons next to each other on GNOME, which has no radio group.

components.name: SearchField
components.description: A search field with a magnifying glass and a clear button: macOS's capsule search field, Windows 11's AutoSuggestBox, or GNOME's search entry.

components.name: Segmented
components.description: A segmented control choosing one of a few views: macOS's NSSegmentedControl, the chosen segment in the accent color as a key window draws it, Windows 11's SelectorBar, or GNOME's AdwToggleGroup.

components.name: Select
components.description: A drop-down choosing one of a list: macOS's pop-up button and menu, Windows 11's ComboBox with its accent pill, or GNOME's drop-down and popover.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A slider setting a value in a range: macOS's capsule knob, Windows 11's thumb with its accent dot, or GNOME's scale.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An indicator of work of unknown length: macOS's spokes, Windows 11's ProgressRing, or GNOME's AdwSpinner.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A switch with the platform's track, knob and motion: a capsule knob on macOS, a growing knob on Windows, a round slider on GNOME.

components.name: Table
components.description: A table of rows and columns whose rows are drawn as the platform draws them: macOS's inset NSTableView with its rounded selection, Windows 11's ListView items with their backplate and accent pill, or GNOME's GtkColumnView with the accent-tinted row. The choice, the sort, the columns and accessibility are MyGo's, as are the header, the cells' padding and the rows' least height.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabs choosing a page: macOS's tab view with the chosen tab on a raised platter, Windows 11's SelectorBar, or GNOME's notebook tabs.

components.name: TextArea
components.description: A multi-line text input in the platform's text view: a bezel-bordered view on macOS, a TextBox on Windows 11, a framed view on GNOME.

components.name: TextAreaBuffer
components.description: A multi-line text input editing a ui.TextBuffer, whose edits never copy the whole document, in the same text view as TextArea: a bezel-bordered view on macOS, a TextBox on Windows 11, a framed view on GNOME. Editing, undo, the selection, input methods and scrolling are MyGo's.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: A single-line text input in the platform's field: macOS's bezeled field with its focus ring, Windows 11's TextBox with the accent line, or GNOME's filled entry.

components.name: TextInputBuffer
components.description: A single-line text input editing a ui.TextBuffer, in the same field as TextInput: macOS's bezeled field with its focus ring, Windows 11's TextBox with the accent line, or GNOME's filled entry. Editing, undo, the selection and input methods are MyGo's.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed: macOS's push-on-push-off button, in the accent color while on as a key window draws it, Windows 11's ToggleButton in the accent color, or GNOME's checked toggle button; in a Toolbar, the platform's toolbar item.

components.name: Tree
components.description: A tree of items that open and close, its rows drawn as the platform draws a tree's: an inset NSOutlineView's rounded selection, Windows 11's TreeView backplate, or GNOME's GtkListView rows. MyGo's TreeItem takes the platform's row colors from a theme the tree builds its items in; the keys and accessibility are MyGo's.

components.name: TreeItem
components.description: An item of a Tree, at the platform's row height, insets, corners and indentation. MyGo's disclosure arrow stays, and WinUI's accent pill on the chosen item is not drawn.
